_comment: Test data for tests/pm-flow/inv-regression.spec.js (Inventory Management regression). Material, supplier and site come from tests/pm-flow/support/pl-flow.js (SCP_PL_MATERIAL / SCP_PL_SUPPLIER / SCP_PL_SITE), because the Procurement regression delivers the stock this suite uses.
_minimumSourceLocationStock: Stock needed at the run's source location (setup picks the real location with the most stock and checks it with the form hint). One run uses about 8-9 units there; 12 leaves a margin. When no location has enough, deliver stock with the Procurement regression (npm run procurement:regression).
_maximumSourceLocationCandidates: Setup ranks real locations by Location-view QTY and checks at most this many with the form hint before giving up.

submittals._comment: Run submittals created by the Procurement regression runs. Imported ones (-SUB-I1/I2) have no schedule lines, so the form tries several candidates. PLD1102-SUB-01 exists twice on the project and the upload rejects it as ambiguous (OBS-INV-13).

locations._comment: Run-created locations are named 'Loc <run tag>' and usually hold no stock, so they are never used as the source location.

secondSite._comment: Site used for the site-isolation check (INV-REG-23). SCP_INV_SITE2 overrides it.

expectedMessages._comment: Application messages observed on NRVC_Hall (INV_SCENARIOS.md). The 3-decimal message is the expected rule; today the app shows only 'Invalid data provided.' (OBS-INV-10).
expectedMessages.overdraw: Not enough stock at .+: only [\d.]+ .+ available, 99999 requested
expectedMessages.zeroQuantity: Quantity cannot be empty or zero or less
expectedMessages.sameLocation: From Location and To Location must be different.
expectedMessages.uploadFailedNothingSaved: The upload failed. Nothing was saved.
